reopened_reason: EW-RS-070 determines which support/sign/parity/magnitude information inside the common exact pair-delta exchange carrier remains scalar-sufficient.

new_assertions.body: Exact pair-delta magnitude is not required by the current common Q-V realization: changed token-coordinate identity plus delta sign is scalar-exact on all three hard carriers.

On 4x5-k4, support-only, parity-only, and unsigned absolute-magnitude delta triangles all leave nine contradictions while sign-only is exact; exchange direction is therefore load-bearing on this carrier.

Signed parity is an independent common-exact realization with ranks 73,282,14 and omits even-magnitude delta coordinates entirely. Thus even-magnitude direction is not universally required by every exact common realization.

The frozen EW-RS-070 selection order chooses DELTA_SIGN_TRIANGLE first, but structural-rank valuation does not totally order sign and signed-parity candidates: sign is lower rank on 6x3-k3 while signed parity is lower rank on 4x5-k4 and 6x3-k4.

The common scalar carrier is now explicitly orientation-independent and directional: the next MSS axis is which token families W, C_i, D0_d, D1_d need signed exchange information, not exact magnitude or H/V/D provenance.
EW-RS-059 formula holdouts remain sealed; RS-070 supplies a coordinate compression, not a frozen closed syndrome formula.
